description: Oriel Notch desktop overlay, installed through the official guided per-user setup.

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Oriel executable was not found at $appExe. The guided setup may not have completed successfully." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Oriel uninstaller was not found at $uninstaller. The guided setup may not have completed successfully." }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $linkPath) { throw "Refusing to overwrite existing managed link: $linkPath" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $linkPath 'oriel.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'The managed Oriel junction does not resolve to oriel.exe.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Registered Oriel uninstaller not found: $uninstaller" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $regExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Windows reg.exe was not found.' }
if (-not $process.WaitForExit(45000)) { Stop-Process -Id $process.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; throw 'Oriel uninstaller timed out after 45 seconds with --silent.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Oriel uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if ($appStillExists) { throw 'Oriel application executable remains after waiting for the uninstaller.' }
if ($registryHits.Count -gt 0) { throw "Oriel uninstall registry data still references the install directory: $($registryHits -join '; ')" }
if ($null -eq $stableSince -or ([DateTime]::UtcNow - $stableSince).TotalSeconds -lt 5) { throw 'Oriel uninstall state did not remain absent for five continuous seconds within 30 seconds.' }
if ($unexpectedFiles.Count -gt 0) { throw "Unexpected files remain in Oriel install directory: $($unexpectedFiles.FullName -join '; ')" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installDir) { throw "Oriel install directory remains after cleanup: $installDir" }

notes: Non-portable package: run Scoop from a normal, non-elevated PowerShell session. Scoop's native installer handler opens the official Oriel setup wizard without command-line switches, waits for it to exit, and removes the downloaded setup file after a successful exit. The pre_install hook renames the versioned download to the stable installer.file name required by Scoop. The program is installed per-user in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Oriel; Scoop creates a Junction in its version directory for the shim and shortcut. User data remains in %APPDATA%\Oriel and Windows Credential Manager. Remove any existing standalone Oriel installation before the first Scoop install. Disable Oriel's automatic update check in Settings > About to keep Scoop as the update authority.
pre_install: if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $installDir -PathType Container) { throw "An existing Oriel installation was found at $installDir. Uninstall it manually before installing this Scoop package." }
if ($registeredOriel.Count -gt 0) { throw "An existing Oriel uninstall registration was found: $($registeredOriel -join '; '). Uninstall it manually before using this Scoop package." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $setup -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Downloaded Oriel setup was not found: $setup" }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scoopInstaller -PathType Leaf) { throw "Refusing to overwrite existing installer file: $scoopInstaller" }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $scoopInstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Could not prepare the Scoop-managed Oriel installer file.' }
